claims: The 6th-seeded Tennessee Volunteers defeated the 2nd-seeded Iowa State Cyclones 76-62 on March 27, 2026, in the Sweet 16.
Tennessee Volunteers advanced to their third consecutive Elite Eight.
Tennessee had a 43-22 rebounding edge over Iowa State.
Tennessee scored 42 points in the paint to Iowa State’s 30 points in the paint.
Nate Ament scored 18 points for Tennessee.
Ja'Kobi Gillespie scored 16 points for Tennessee.
Felix Okpara scored 12 points and 10 rebounds for Tennessee.
Jaylen Carey scored 11 points and 10 rebounds for Tennessee.
Nate Heise scored 18 points for Iowa State.
Tamin Lipsey scored 18 points for Iowa State.
Iowa State played without injured star Joshua Jefferson.
Tennessee advances to face No. 1 seed Michigan in the Midwest Region final.
Tennessee’s matchup against Michigan is on Sunday
